AVAILABLE_CHECKS.description: Checks for various internationalization best practices.
Detects runtime changes to PHP error reporting configuration or WordPress debug constants.
Detects the usage of code obfuscation tools.
Detects content that does not comply with the WordPress.org plugin guidelines.
Detects the usage of hidden and compressed files, VCS directories, application files, badly named files, Library Core Files, AI development directories, and unexpected markdown files.
Checks adherence to the Headers requirements.
Checks that all output is escaped before being sent to the browser.
Checks that redirects use wp_safe_redirect() instead of wp_redirect() for security.
Prevents altering WordPress update routines or using custom updaters, which are not allowed on WordPress.org.
Checks related to plugin uninstallation.
Runs PHP_CodeSniffer to detect certain best practices plugins should follow for submission on WordPress.org.
Checks the usage of direct database queries, which should be avoided.
Checks for potentially slow database queries when using WP_Query
Checks whether a loading strategy is explicitly set for JavaScript files, as loading scripts in the footer is usually desired.
Checks whether scripts and styles are properly enqueued using the recommended way.
Checks adherence to the readme.txt requirements.
Detects the usage of Localhost/127.0.0.1 in the plugin.
Detects disallowed usage of ALLOW_UNFILTERED_UPLOADS.
Checks the usage of trademarks or other projects in the plugin slug.
Prevents using remote services that are not necessary.
Detects if plugins save data in the plugin folder instead of using the uploads directory or database.
Ensures sanitization in register_setting().
Checks plugin for unique prefixing for everything the plugin defines in the public namespace.
Checks the escaping in direct database queries.
Detects minified PHP files and tokenization errors.
Checks that PHP files have proper guards to prevent direct file access.
Detects external URLs used in top-level WordPress admin menu, which disrupts the expected user experience.
Checks whether WordPress functions used by the plugin are compatible with its minimum supported WordPress version.
Recommends the WordPress AI Client when a plugin integrates directly with a third-party AI provider.
Checks whether the cumulative size of all scripts enqueued on a page exceeds 293 KB.
Checks whether the cumulative size of all stylesheets enqueued on a page exceeds 293 KB.
Checks whether any stylesheets are loaded on all pages, which is usually not desirable and can lead to performance issues.
Checks whether any scripts are loaded on all pages, which is usually not desirable and can lead to performance issues.
Checks whether scripts and styles are enqueued using a recommended loading strategy.
